about: The activation checks, kept as data. engine.js runs every check on every order. A new check that uses an existing rule type is one entry here; a new kind of rule needs a few lines in engine.js.

checks.name: Pay type, derived not typed
checks.why: A financed deal marked paid in full means the finance company is never set up or paid, and the policy can cancel.
checks.next_step: Change the pay type to {derived|lower} before binding.

how_to_fix.means: The pay type was typed in by hand and does not match the paperwork.
how_to_fix.confirm: A premium finance agreement on file means financed. A carrier's own installment plan is not financing.
how_to_fix.tell_customer: Nothing. This is our record to fix.
how_to_fix.hand_off: If the finance agreement and what the customer was told disagree, pass it to a licensed teammate.

checks.name: Real business address
checks.why: Carriers rate and inspect the place the business works. A PO box or private mailbox is not a location.
checks.says: The business address is a mailbox ({address}).
checks.next_step: Ask the customer for the street address where the business operates.
checks.customer_message: Hi {contact}, before your {line|lower} policy can start, we need the street address where {business} operates. The insurance company can't use a PO box as the business location. Can you reply with the street address?

how_to_fix.means: The only address we have is a mailbox.
how_to_fix.confirm: Look for a street address anywhere else in the file before asking.
how_to_fix.tell_customer: Ask for the street address where the work happens. Keep the PO box as the mailing address if they want it.
how_to_fix.hand_off: If the business truly has no fixed location (a food truck, a mobile crew), pass it to a licensed teammate.

checks.name: Subjectivities (carrier documents)
checks.why: A carrier document nobody asked for holds up the policy late, after the customer thinks it is done.
checks.says: The carrier still needs the {missing|lower}, and nobody has asked for it.
checks.next_step: Send the customer one message listing what is still needed.
checks.customer_message: Hi {contact}, before your {line|lower} policy can start on {effective_date}, the insurance company needs your {missing|lower}.[[ We're also still waiting on your {waiting|lower}.]] You can reply to this message with {it_or_them}.

how_to_fix.means: Something on the carrier's list is neither received nor requested.
how_to_fix.confirm: Check the inbox first. Documents sent by email count as received.
how_to_fix.tell_customer: One message, every missing item, before the chase starts.
how_to_fix.hand_off: If the customer asks why the carrier needs it, a licensed teammate answers.

checks.name: Amounts match
checks.why: If the invoice and the sold price differ, the customer is billed a number they never agreed to, or coverage changed.
checks.says: Sold at {premium_sold}, but the carrier invoice says {carrier_invoice}.
checks.next_step: A licensed teammate confirms the right amount with the carrier before binding.

how_to_fix.means: The price we sold and the price the carrier bills are different.
how_to_fix.confirm: Look for a carrier fee or a changed coverage limit that explains the gap.
how_to_fix.tell_customer: Nothing until a licensed teammate knows the right number.
how_to_fix.hand_off: Always. A price change can mean a coverage change.

checks.name: Billing matches
checks.why: Agency bill and direct bill send the invoice to different places. The wrong one means a missed payment.
checks.says: Our record says {billing|lower}, but the carrier uses {carrier_billing|lower}.

how_to_fix.means: We and the carrier disagree on who sends the bill.
how_to_fix.confirm: The carrier's binder or quote says how it bills.
how_to_fix.tell_customer: Only if who bills them changes. Tell them who the bill will come from.
how_to_fix.hand_off: If the customer was promised a billing type the carrier will not do.

checks.name: Source known
checks.why: Instant and broker deals bind differently. An unknown source sends the order down the wrong path.
checks.says: Source is {source|lower} on our record and {carrier_source|lower} on the carrier's.
checks.next_step: Set the source from the carrier record.

how_to_fix.means: We don't know, or disagree about, whether this came from an instant quote or a broker.
how_to_fix.confirm: The carrier record is the source of truth for how the quote was made.
how_to_fix.hand_off: If neither record says, ask the person who sold it.

checks.name: Certificate on an active policy
checks.why: A certificate on a policy that is not active tells someone there is cover when there is not.
checks.says: A certificate is requested, but the policy is still {policy_status|lower}.
checks.next_step: Hold the certificate. A licensed teammate tells the customer when it can be issued.

how_to_fix.means: Someone wants proof of insurance before the policy exists.
how_to_fix.confirm: Check the policy status with the carrier, not only our record.
how_to_fix.tell_customer: A licensed teammate tells them the date the certificate can be issued.
